Elena — thanks for the clear ask. A few points from Legal: 

1) Audit rights: Redwood accepts reasonable audit rights for SOC 2 and related compliance artifacts. For security-sensitive artifacts (full pen-test reports, redacted logs) we require an NDA and a limited engagement with predefined scope and timing. Frequency: annual by default; ad-hoc audits can be discussed for material incidents.

2) Subprocessors: attached is our exported subprocessor list (production inference, telemetry, backups). We call out which subprocessors process customer data and which operate purely for telemetry/analytics. PHI in inference mode is processed in our HIPAA-capable offering (Private + dedicated deployments). For hosted customers, we have a documented cross-border transfers policy and SCCs where required.

3) HIPAA addendum: We can accept MedAtlas HIPAA language with two minor exceptions around retention and incident notification windows; redlines attached. If those are acceptable to MedAtlas, we will prepare DocuSign for signature.

Attachments: DPA_redlines_MedAtlas_v1.docx (docx), subprocessor_export_20260713.csv (csv)
